findings.title: Newly imported members via CSV bulk import not searchable until next-day index rebuild
findings.description: Customer imported a batch of ~40 faculty via CSV on Monday around 11am; the import reported success and the total member count updated immediately, but the new members could not be found by name in member search for the rest of the day. They became searchable overnight, appearing by the next morning. This has recurred on multiple batches (reliably, every batch of ~40), and blocks the post-import team-assignment workflow (coaches/teams) for the remainder of the day it's imported, roughly doubling the customer's setup timeline. Workaround agreed on the call: run imports at end of day so the overnight index rebuild catches members up before the next day's sorting work.
findings.quote: They'd search for a teacher by name in the member search, and nothing would come up
findings.severity_reason: Real defect blocking a workflow step (team/coach assignment) for a day per batch, but a viable workaround exists (end-of-day imports) and scope is limited to the day-of-import window.
findings.match_note: Same symptom (newly created members unsearchable until next day's index build, member count unaffected) and same scope (newly created members) as PROJ-131; only the creation path differs (CSV bulk import vs. individual invite), and the call explicitly ties this to the same tracked issue.
